items.title: AI Labeling: Two new labels are meant to tell you whether AI was used on a track
items.excerpt: The industry's biggest trade bodies — IFPI, RIAA, A2IM, WIN, IMPALA, the Grammys, SAG-AFTRA and the Human Artistry Campaign — jointly introduced two standard labels, 'AI-Generated' and 'AI-Assisted,' to disclose how AI was used on a track. It sets a shared disclosure standard that directly shapes how AI-assisted creators tag and release their work.

items.title: Meaw Chain review: can it make “vibe mixing” a thing?
items.excerpt: Safari Audio's Meaw Chain uses AI to generate entire plugin/mixing chains from a text prompt, offering producers an accessible route to a finished-sounding mix. MusicTech weighs whether AI-driven 'vibe mixing' is genuinely useful across different skill levels.

items.title: Neutone and Roland want you to design your own AI model — and play it live
items.excerpt: Roland and Neutone's Project LYDIA is a prototype AI effects pedal that lets musicians build their own custom AI models and perform with them in real time, using 'neural sampling' to transfer the timbre of one sound onto another while preserving a player's dynamics and nuance.

items.title: ACE Studio 2 review: Next-gen AI features, stone age workflows
items.excerpt: ACE Studio 2 is an AI-centric DAW built around vocal synthesis (140+ voices and 36 AI virtual instruments) plus generative 'Add a Layer' and 'Music Enhancer' tools. MusicTech finds the next-gen AI capabilities genuinely powerful but hampered by sluggish rendering and rough workflows.
